seo_article.what_it_is: AI Agents Skills is an open agent skill resource: a reusable procedure, instruction pack, or capability layer that should make an agent better at a repeatable task than one-off prompting.
seo_article.why_it_matters: AI Agents Skills matters because skill files are becoming a standard way to package procedural knowledge for agents. A curated repository helps builders see what reusable agent instructions look like in practice.
